summary: A mixed day with significant legal developments and retail sector updates. Key focus on judicial decisions, regulatory movements in commodities markets, and retail consolidation activity.

bullets.text: Supreme Court dismisses plea challenging Justice PK Mishra's son's appointment as Rajasthan Additional Advocate General.
NCDEX launches RAINCHNNAI weather derivatives futures, allowing market participants to hedge Chennai monsoon risks commercially.
GRT Jewellers acquires 74% stake in TBZ for ₹1,034 crore, expanding pan-India presence in jewellery retail.
Government likely discussing import duty cuts on gold/silver as higher tariffs fail to curb imports, fuel grey market.
Zomato implements zero-tolerance policy banning analogue dairy dishes, enforcing corrective action on non-compliant restaurants.
